topic: How to Read a Cash Flow Forecast
objective: Explain the basics of interpreting a cash flow forecast.

slides.subheadline: A forecast is a tool, not a prediction to fear.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A cash flow forecast estimates money moving in and out of your business over coming weeks or months. The goal isn't precision — it's visibility. Spotting a projected shortfall a month ahead gives you time to act, rather than discovering it the week rent is due.

caption:
The value of a cash flow forecast isn't perfect accuracy — it's early warning. A well-maintained forecast shows roughly when a shortfall might occur, giving you weeks rather than days to plan around it, whether that's adjusting spending or arranging finance ahead of time.

Even a simple spreadsheet, updated regularly, beats no forecast at all.
